text:
tess: hi team, first week here — hitting a roadblock setting up monitoring for the private-runtime service. Datadog dashboards show but monitors button 403s, Grafana alerting UI is disabled on our folder, and no Sentry DSN in secrets. who do I ping to get these unlocked?

devex-bot: Welcome! Quick steps: 1) request eng-observability group add 2) request Grafana folder Editor+Alerting 3) open infra ticket for Sentry project (use template obs-onboard). Docs: https://redwood.internal/obs/onboard :robot_face:

nate: Hey @tess — for Datadog 403 usually = missing app key permissions (monitors_write). If you want I can create a short-lived monitor under my app key to validate routing. Paste the dashboard link.

ryan: For Grafana the alert UI being disabled could be either folder perms or org-level alerting off for private clusters. Hover tooltip text matters. If it says "no permission" ping me and I9ll grant Editor+Alerting. If it says "feature disabled" I need infra toggle.

tess: dashboard link: https://datadog.redwood.internal/dash/zz99/private-runtime. Hover shows "insufficient permissions".

ryan: OK that9s perms. I9ll add you as Editor+Alerting on the `private-runtime` folder in a few mins. Log out/in after I update to refresh session.

infra-bot: To provision Sentry project include: org email domain, desired slug (e.g., private-runtime-tess), repo/service name, envs. Use infra ticket template: https://redwood.internal/infra/new?template=obs-onboard

tess: Filed ticket OBS-2044 with slug private-runtime-tess and linked dashboard. Nate, happy to have you create the test monitor while perms churn. Thanks all! :heart:
